name: rdl-agent-workspace

scripts.check: biome lint ./ && biome check ./ && biome format ./
scripts.build:all: bun run build:linux-x64 && bun run build:macos-arm64 && bun run build:windows-x64

//build: One binary IS the whole app: GUI by default, `<app> mcp-shim …` (it re-execs itself, so agent sessions work with no extra files) and `<app> serve` for headless. It still needs poppler-utils + ImageMagick for PDF text/raster feedback — off PATH, or in a `bin/` folder next to the binary, or via $LAYOUT_TOOLS_DIR (embedding those is a separate packaging job: both are heavily dynamically linked). GPUIX ships a native addon per platform and Bun only embeds the one it can resolve at build time, so build:macos-arm64 / build:windows-x64 produce a loadable binary only when run on that OS (or a CI runner with its @gpuix/native-*) — from the wrong host they exit 0 but cannot open a window. `build` (no target) is the always-correct host build.
